name: Dawn

rounds.endCondition: After round 6 (the Great Buildings round) affiliations are revealed and Great Buildings resolved

categories.label: Treasure in your Storehouse
categories.labelVi: Kho báu trong Storehouse của bạn
categories.hint: Sum of printed Treasure on your face-down Storehouse cards (can be negative). 7 or more = Scoundrel, under 7 = Ally.

categories.label: Town Prosperity (all constructed buildings)
categories.hint: Total Prosperity of constructed Town Buildings + Great Buildings (resolve Great Buildings first).

categories.label: Number of Allies
categories.hint: Players with under 7 Treasure in their Storehouse. Allies need 30 Prosperity per Ally.

categories.label: Won
categories.hint: Allies win together if Prosperity >= 30 x Allies; otherwise the Scoundrel with the most Storehouse treasure wins.

tiebreakers.description: If the town fails, the Scoundrel with the most Storehouse treasure wins. Ties among Scoundrels are not addressed in the rulebook.

notes: family: deduction (semi-coop hidden-role). Verified against the official rulebook (Green Meadow Games Google Doc): affiliation is decided at game end by Storehouse treasure (7 or more = Scoundrel), the 'discarded chests' wording in earlier reviews refers to the Storehouse card each player places every round. Great Buildings (resolved at end of round 6): #1 needs 10 successes -> 30 Prosperity; #2 needs 6 -> 10 per Ally with no Wounds in hand; #3 needs 8 -> 4 per constructed Town Building; #4 needs 18 -> 20. Not specified: ties among Scoundrels, case with zero Allies or zero Scoundrels.
winCondition: After round 6, resolve Great Buildings and total Prosperity. If Prosperity >= 30 x number of Allies, all Allies win and Scoundrels lose. Otherwise the Scoundrel with the most Treasure in their Storehouse wins.
